newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA says Pan-Alberta to defend itself.
newsitem.headline: NOVA says Pan-Alberta to defend itself.

text.p: Pan-Alberta Gas Ltd will "vigorously defend itself" against a group of Canadian gas producers suing it over alleged breaches of fiduciary and contractual obligations since 1992, a spokesman for NOVA Corp, an indirect part owner of Pan-Alberta, said on Tuesday.

"All I Can say is that we've received the statement of claim (and) we're in the process of investigating it. Pan-Alberta will vigorously defend itself agianst the claim," NOVA's Paul Clark told Reuters.
"But, given the complex nature of the matters raised by the claim, we're unable to comment any further."
A group of Canadian natural gas producers on Friday filed a lawsuit against the gas aggregator, claiming the company may have breached its arm's-length relationship with NOVA.
The suit asks for damages of C$5 million and other costs. The action also states that actual damages may exceed C$50 million. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
